name: Per-User Visibility
description: Restrict what each user can see inside a library. The administrator picks the visible series per user; hidden items are fully invisible (HTTP 404), not merely unplayable, and the selection survives metadata refreshes.
overview: Per-user, per-library visibility enforced by Jellyfin's own tag filters.

versions.changelog: Whole-library grants now also open the library entry, and revoking one closes it again unless single items inside are still granted. Fixes a revoked whole-library grant that left the library visible to the user.

Initial release. Per-library visibility scopes for individual users, enforced by Jellyfin's own tag filters. Includes a sidebar page with per-library item selection and whole-library grants, and locks the tag field so metadata refreshes do not drop the restriction.
